From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Subject: Post-call: Exec recap & next steps (NovaHealth digital triage pilot)

Thanks again for the time today, Sam — great conversation. As discussed, I wanted to capture an executive-level recap so your leadership and procurement teams have a clear summary of what we covered and the proposed next steps.

High-level business outcomes you shared
- Reduce ED triage time by 25% and average length-of-stay for low-acuity patients by 10% within Q4 pilot.
- Shift ~15% of inbound triage traffic to virtual/self-service to reduce staffing pressure and cost-per-visit.
- Improve patient satisfaction for initial contact/resolution.

Primary pain points
- Current triage workflow is manual and creates bottlenecks during peak hours.
- Limited ability to route based on clinical risk and existing EHR signals in real time.
- Cost sensitivity: procurement expects clear unit economics and an implementation budget cap for the pilot.

Scope we discussed (pilot)
- 3 ED sites, 6-week technical pilot, integration with Epic for read-only patient context, Redwood-hosted inference runtime (dedicated pool) with option to move to Private VPC.

Risk & escalation items for leadership
- Data access: we need read-only clinical context (chiefly chief complaint + vitals + encounter id). Legal/compliance will validate the access path.
- SLA/uptime: Pilot asks for 99.5% availability during business hours; we'll propose Dedicated capacity with failover to hosted variants.
- Procurement: procurement will expect an order form / MSA redline and estimated spend cap for pilot.

Procurement path (as you outlined)
- You will introduce Procurement + Legal (procurement@novahealth.ai).
- Typical internal approvals: Procurement -> IT Security quick review -> VP of Product / COO sign-off.

Attachments included
- Redwood-Exec-Deck.pdf (exec-level overview + pricing bands)
- NovaHealth-MVP-requirements.xlsx (notes from today, action items to confirm)

Proposed next steps (please confirm timelines):
1) Schedule 30-min exec alignment call (you + VP of Product / COO + our CEO or Head of Sales) — target week of 6/22.
2) Procurement contact and high-level template MSA to be shared by NovaHealth; we’ll prepare an order form and pilot quote (target 72 hours).
3) Rishi to scope integration work and provide a technical checklist for Epic read-only keys.

Let me know if I misstated anything. If it looks good, could you introduce us to procurement and Amanda (VP Product) so we can get the approvals and SOW work started?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
